item.title: Rallying Cry – November 3, 2026
item.description: Brazil leads the charge with a global roadmap to phase out fossil fuels, while a promising diabetes implant shows hope for mice, blueberries brighten moods in older adults, and a wheelchair skateboarding teacher inspires with his resilience.
